note: VARIETY: Hong Kong / Guangzhou Cantonese. SCRIPT: Traditional Han characters. REGISTER — THE critical rule: write COLLOQUIAL WRITTEN CANTONESE (口語, how people actually speak), NEVER Standard Written Chinese (書面語 / Mandarin-based). Use Cantonese function words: 係 (not 是), 唔 (not 不), 冇 (not 沒有), 嘅 (not 的 possessive), 咗 (perfective, not 了), 喺 (at/in, not 在), 佢 (he/she, not 他/她), 哋 (plural, 我哋/你哋/佢哋), 乜嘢/咩 (what), 邊度 (where), 而家 (now), 想 (want), 識 (know how/can), 畀 (give), 嘢 (thing). Sentence-final particles 呀/㗎/喇/啦/囉 are natural. Yes/no via A-not-A (明唔明). Jyutping NOT in the target field. These are native-quality anchors — match this register exactly.
